title: The lengths can name the codes
hook: Code lengths can determine an assignment without describing a tree.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Construct canonical prefix codes from code lengths without transmitting the original tree shape.

misconception: Huffman decoding always requires the exact original left-right tree.
objective: Construct canonical prefix codes from code lengths without transmitting the original tree shape.

claims.text: Codes increase within a length and shift left when the length grows. Given valid code lengths and the agreed symbol ordering, both sides reconstruct the same prefix assignment without transmitting the original tree shape.
